// A volume with a function, a call, a returned literal and an object read —
// enough shapes that the model concludes about it rather than staying silent.
const settings = { mode: "strict", depth: 2 };

function pick(key) {
    return settings[key];
}

function run(input) {
    const mode = pick("mode");
    if (mode) {
        return input;
    }
    return null;
}

module.exports = { run, pick };
